svg.aria-label: Concept drawing of a 3-phase 12-coil 16-pole spiral-coil PCB stator
svg.title: embodic spiral-coil stator concept (12 coils / 16 poles) — concept drawing, not computed geometry
svg.text: embodic — 3-phase multi-layer spiral-coil PCB stator: CONCEPT (not computed geometry)
Default candidate 12 coils / 16 poles (fractional-slot concentrated, all phases on every layer). Not to scale.
A Coil plan — one layer pair, viewed from rotor 1
r_i, r_o = active coil radii (default 18–38 mm, assumption).
Inner ring: 16 rotor poles (N black, S white). Coil pitch 30° = 240° el.; pole pitch 22.5°.
Numbering CCW (+θ): A C B ×4, all positive (CW arrows); rotor turning +θ → sequence A→B→C.
B Layer stack of one coil (series pairs, option M2)
Vc = centre via (coil eye); Vt = outer transfer via (coil rim).
Through vias (grey) must be clear on layers they do not join.
Hatched P2 = option M3: pair rotated by ½ coil pitch (15°).
Each box = one coil through all its layer pairs (panel B).
Reversal = enter the coil at its other outer terminal.
circulation of positive phase current (CW / CCW)
terminal pad (U, V, W; N = star point)
layer pair rotated by ½ coil pitch (option)
Status: concept only (design assumption). Phase pattern from the star-of-slots check (checks/kw.py); no dimension, turn count, field or electrical value is implied.
